steps.b:
An equation shows reactants (reaktanti) turning into products (proizvodi). Atoms are not created or destroyed, so every element must have the same count on both sides — that’s balancing (izjednačavanje).

You balance only with coefficients in front. Never change indices — H₂O would become a different substance.

Order that usually works: metals → nonmetals → H → O last. Then check every element.

A recipe and a bank statement at once: every atom that goes in must come out.

• Synthesis (sinteza): A + B → AB. 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO
  • Decomposition (analiza): AB → A + B. CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂
  • Single replacement (supstitucija): Zn + 2HCl → ZnCl₂ + H₂
  • Exchange (dvostruka izmena): AgNO₃ + NaCl → AgCl↓ + NaNO₃
  • Neutralization: HCl + NaOH → NaCl + H₂O
  • Combustion (sagorevanje): CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O

Reactions that release heat are exothermic; those that absorb heat are endothermic.

(s) solid, (l) liquid, (g) gas, (aq) dissolved in water. ↓ means a precipitate (talog) forms, ↑ means a gas escapes.

Trick for O₂ with an odd number of O on the right: double everything else first. For C₂H₆ + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O you get 2C₂H₆ + 7O₂ → 4CO₂ + 6H₂O.

s: O: 2 on the left, 3 on the right → the common multiple is 6: 3O₂ and 2Fe₂O₃.
Fe: now 4 on the right → 4Fe on the left.
